messages:
oliver_sales: Hey team — buyer wants a one-page artifact checklist to mark POC complete and needs clarity on whether we can share the full pen-test report or just a redacted version. Also asks if dedicated pricing must be agreed before POC. Deadline: Thu.

hannah_ps: Minimal POC artifact pack we usually send: SOC 2 Type II attestation (or signed controls summary), pen-test attestation letter (signed) or redacted exec summary, UAT/staging network diagram, SSO/SAML test instructions + test account, staging IP whitelist or VPN details, short POC runbook (support hours + escalation).

hannah_ps: Dedicated/reserved pricing is optional. we can run POC on shared infra. if they need guaranteed latency we can quote a short reserved window; that does not need to be signed to start basic tests.

sam_security: Pen-test sharing policy: default = signed attestation + redacted findings summary. Full report requires NDA, legal approval, and a secure dataroom. we will not disclose raw scanner logs or vendor credentials. if they request vendor name or test date we can include those in the attestation.

sam_security: we can also provide a "temporary attestation" noting controls status and remediation plan for noncritical gaps (good for customers who have recent changes).

diego_ops: Staging IPs — for quick POCs we provision ephemeral CIDR blocks (2-week window). example whitelist they can paste:
```
- UAT ingress: 54.33.120.0/28
- Callbacks: 54.33.120.16/30
- Admin API (ephemeral): 54.33.120.21
```
Static public IPs possible but require ~5 business days lead time and may affect billing if reserved capacity is needed.

oliver_sales: Can someone format that into a one-page acceptance checklist i can email? buyer asked specifically: "is network diagram + SSO + pen-test attestation enough to sign off?"

hannah_ps: Short answer: usually yes, provided the pen-test attestation states no outstanding critical findings and SSO is validated in staging end-to-end. Proposed one-pager:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation OR signed controls summary
- Pen-test attestation (signed) OR redacted exec summary (statement of no open criticals + remediation ETA for any high findings)
- Network architecture diagram for UAT/staging (include on-prem connectors)
- SSO/SAML test user validated in staging
- Staging IP whitelist or VPN details
- POC support hours and escalation contact
- Optional: KMS/key custody statement if required by buyer

sam_security: I'll attach the standard pen-test attestation template and can redline if legal requests changes. If they insist on the full report, request CISO/legal contact and reason — we'll prepare a dataroom under NDA.

diego_ops: Ping me if they want static IPs or a month-long reserved window and i'll open the ops ticket.

oliver_sales: Thanks all — i'll send the checklist and ask whether they want redacted summary or full report. looping you if they press on static IPs or reserved pricing :thumbsup:
